# FastNoiseLite

Vendored C# source from [Auburn/FastNoiseLite](https://github.com/Auburn/FastNoiseLite),
commit `785f37a9ad76e283586a379675085f2063ae03f7`.
The only local change is removal of trailing whitespace. The upstream
`FastNoiseLite.cs` SHA-256 is
`605090835008f4ef58fc39cdfa15df5051a4f5575d5e01fd7d355b9f67b0160e`;
the normalized local file is
`ca79c42eb8b698dcad9c732084f88554e95cba207677eacad5ca24c1baded59d`.

Its MIT license is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
It supplies reproducible noise samples only; ocean, lake, river, climate and
gameplay rules belong to ClankerWorld.
